body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> CYPRESS presented a keyboard designed for programmers during CES 2007. Anybody can use it regardless of the left-handed or right-handed; it can rotate from left to right and you can also lift it up or lower down to adjust height.
No words on availability and price.
